task_name: PATCH card priority, labels, project, and phase

concerns_addressed: diffIds extracted to server/src/core/diff-ids.ts and imported by card-assignees, card-labels, tracker-items label sync, and tracker-assignees (import-only fallout from removing diffAssigneeIds).

PATCH /cards/:id wires priorityId, labelIds, projectId, and phaseId with parse-before-write, transactional syncCardLabels on card_labels, recordActivity to card_events, and preserved optional-version semantics (server/src/routes/cards.ts:393-612).

Board effective-project guard lives in parseCardProjectPhase using the card's current project_id for phase-only updates; parseProjectPhase body is unchanged (server/src/routes/tracker-item-parsers.ts:120-251).

HTTP integration suite covers set/clear, 409 stale version, cross-workspace/wrong-kind rejection paths, phase-only guards, projectId-null with phase, labels-only without version, and statusId rejection on POST/PATCH (server/src/routes/cards-taxonomy.integration.test.ts).
statusId remains rejected on PATCH; no status_id writes added to the taxonomy PATCH path.

strengths: diffIds is shared across assignee sync (card-assignees, tracker-assignees), tracker item labels, and card labels — eliminating the misleading diffAssigneeIds reuse.
syncCardLabels writes only to card_labels with diff-based junction updates; no tracker_item_labels usage for cards.

parseCardProjectPhase correctly enforces effective-project semantics: phase-only rejected without a card project, allowed only when phase belongs to the card's project, and projectId:null with non-null phase rejected via unchanged parseProjectPhase.

Optional-version behavior is preserved: labels-only PATCH without a version key succeeds and bumps version; version-gated updates use the existing $if(version !== undefined) pattern in both hasSets and assignee-only branches.
Thirteen real HTTP integration scenarios exercise 4xx/409 contracts end-to-end with DB state assertions; unit suites for diffIds, parsers, and syncCardLabels all pass (30/30).
Tracker route semantics unchanged beyond diffIds import swap in tracker-items.ts and tracker-assignees.ts.
Conventional commit feat(board-tracker): add card taxonomy patch validation at reviewed SHA.

issues.description: The grouped cross-workspace/wrong-kind HTTP bullet does not include explicit cases for cross-workspace label/phase or wrong-kind priority at the HTTP layer; label wrong-kind and cross-workspace priority/project are covered, and parser unit tests cover priority/label kind filtering.
diffIds behavior is duplicated between server/src/core/diff-ids.test.ts and server/src/routes/cards.assignees.test.ts with near-identical cases.
tracker-item-parsers.ts grew to 305 lines (from 232) after adding parsePriorityId and parseCardProjectPhase; growth is spec-mandated but crosses the ~300-line refactor heuristic.
cards.assignees.test.ts and tracker-assignees.ts are outside the task file list but required to update imports after removing diffAssigneeIds; changes are import-only with no behavioral delta.
